CLI args are merged into Config via CliOverrides.
Phase 0: pipeline calls scanner::scan to produce ScanData consumed by all later stages.
Builds the task DAG of research/compose agent specs executed level-by-level.
run_spec executes each agent spec's agentic loop against a backend.
PipelineCtx holds constructed AgentBackend instances keyed by BackendKind.
Write/Verify stages call writer, verify, and summary entry points.
Content-hash cache stored on PipelineCtx for incremental gating.
Daily cap and audit log enforced during agent calls.
PromptLoader renders templates from prompts/ with injected context.
Manifest fingerprint feeds incremental gate and agentic-mode cache keys.
Runner builds AgentRequest, invokes AgentBackend::run, and consumes AgentResult/TokenUsage.
Runner reads PipelineCtx (config, cache, quota, semaphore, cancel) — a mutual module reference with pipeline.
LLM JSON output is parsed into typed reports via the lenient deserializers.
Prompt materials render ScanData/DirectoryInfo and tree views for agents.
Registry wires report schemas into agent specs.
for_kind dispatches BackendKind::Claude to the claude CLI backend.
for_kind dispatches BackendKind::Codex to the codex CLI backend.
for_kind dispatches BackendKind::Devin to the devin CLI backend.
Scripted mock backend implements AgentBackend for offline tests.
Renders DatabaseOverviewReport into 6.Database-Overview.md.
Renders BoundaryAnalysisReport into the boundary document.
write_docs reads results out of PipelineCtx's ResearchContext.
Verify stage inspects pipeline outputs for integrity and mermaid syntax.
Drift loads CoreDependency claims produced by the relationship analysis.
Reuses the deterministic scan to enumerate files for import extraction.
Extracts RawImport/ImportSpec per language via js/python/rust parsers.
Resolves raw imports into repo-internal files via build_file_graph.

Verdict chain C1–C12 operates over the lifted file/node graph.
Report filters findings against a saved baseline of known issues.
Markdown templates are loaded and rendered at runtime; no code-level reference.

Integration tests exercise pipeline, drift, and incremental paths via the library crate.
Offline tests drive the pipeline through the scripted mock backend.
Python fixture app provides scan/drift input for tests.
Rust fixture crate exercises Rust import extraction and resolution.

key_insights: Layered pipeline architecture: scanner (deterministic Phase 0) → agent orchestration (LLM fan-out) → output rendering, coordinated centrally by src/pipeline's PipelineCtx.
src/pipeline is the hub: it depends on scanner, agent, backend, output, cache, quota, prompt, and manifest, making it the highest fan-out module and the main integration point.

There is a mutual module reference between src/pipeline and src/agent/runner.rs: pipeline calls run_spec while runner imports PipelineCtx — a mild cyclic dependency at module level, mitigated by Rust's crate-internal visibility but worth watching.
The AgentBackend trait in src/backend cleanly decouples the pipeline from CLI backends; adding a new agent CLI only requires a new backend file plus a BackendKind variant.
src/drift is a self-contained read-only subsystem (claims → imports → resolve → compare → report) that reuses scanner and agent::reports but never calls LLM backends — good separation of concerns.
Prompt templates under prompts/ and prompts/editors/ are pure runtime data dependencies (DataFlow); changing them alters behavior without any code change, so they behave like configuration.
agent::reports' lenient deserialization layer is a key integration seam: every LLM-produced JSON funnels through it, centralizing robustness against malformed model output.
No circular dependencies exist between major subsystems (scanner, agent, backend, output, drift); the only cycle is the pipeline↔runner pair.
tests depend on the library plus mock backend and fixture trees rather than real CLIs, keeping the suite hermetic; e2e_real_cli is the only opt-in external dependency.
Potential issue: drift reuses agent::reports::CoreDependency as its claims format, coupling the drift analyzer to the LLM report schema — schema changes there propagate into drift claims parsing.
